basic:
qa:
  needs: build
  if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
  runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
  timeout-minutes: 40
  permissions:
    contents: read
  env:
    DISPLAY: ':99'
    LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
  steps:
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
      with:
        name: linux-player
        path: Build
    - name: Prepare Linux rendering
      shell: bash
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y xvfb x11-utils libgl1-mesa-dri libglu1-mesa libasound2t64 libx11-dev libxcursor1 libxrandr2 libxinerama1 libxi6
        chmod +x Build/Game.x86_64
        Xvfb "$DISPLAY" -screen 0 1280x720x24 -ac +extension GLX +render -noreset > /tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 &
        for attempt in {1..20}; do
          if xdpyinfo -display "$DISPLAY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
          sleep 1
        done
        exit 1
    - name: Verify test cases
      id: artel
      uses: project-artel/qa-action@v0.1.0-alpha.1
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.ARTEL_TOKEN }}
        project-id: ${{ vars.ARTEL_PROJECT_ID }}
        test-run-id: ${{ vars.ARTEL_TEST_RUN_ID }}
        build-path: ./Build/Game.x86_64
        timeout: '1800'
advanced:
- name: Verify test cases
  id: artel
  uses: project-artel/qa-action@4ccc630d3bf3e6d24580e5e5796b1a4549ce5382
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.ARTEL_TOKEN }}
    project-id: ${{ vars.ARTEL_PROJECT_ID }}
    test-run-id: ${{ vars.ARTEL_TEST_RUN_ID }}
    build-path: ./Build/Game.x86_64
    model: MODEL_ID
    key-source: user
    arch: '{"engine":"planner_executer"}'
    language: ko
